about.label: About Us
about.title: Condominium Management Authority
about.desc: Sri Lanka's premier regulatory body for condominium property management
about.role_desc: The Condominium Management Authority (CMA) was established under the Condominium Property Act No. 12 of 1973. The CMA is responsible for the registration and regulation of condominium properties and management corporations throughout Sri Lanka.
about.vision_desc: Condominiums as a solution to the housing requirement of the country.
about.mission_desc: Constructing condominium property to be apposite with the benefit and welfare of residents and establishing management corporations for the systematic administration and management of such property.
about.quality_desc: To endeavor to enhance the positive approach of the stakeholders to ensure the development of the condominium industry sector efficiently and productively as a service management organization to satisfy our clients.
